context: Ravengard has fallen (abducted or believed dead), and Counsellor Florrick confronts the party—arriving with upper‑city patriars and guards—and accuses Wyll of slaughtering his father to seize power. She and her allies are initially poised for battle but can be calmed when the player insists they intend to find or save Ravengard. Florrick then reveals Ravengard knew of the Absolute and, before his capture, entrusted Wyll with a charge: use his father's lessons to awaken Ansur, the wyrm beneath the city. She says a stolen tome, "The Legend of Ansur," will show the way; Wyll’s questionable reputation (including rumors of a devil’s pact) fuels much of the distrust.
